text:
maria: Quick share from tonight's autotune across L4/T4/A10 vs A100/H100. Ran the seq-len sweep + KV stress runs. Posting highlights.

aj: Thanks — can you paste the perf diffs? numbers + config that produced the reg?

maria: Sure. Short summary: on A100/H100 we consistently get ~1.8x tokens/sec vs L4 for long sequences (>=1024). On L4/T4/A10 we see a smaller gap for short seqs (<128) where the small-kernel path wins. Biggest surprise: T4 shows a 15% p95 latency regression at seqlen=1024 when KV cache hot paths are enabled.

kevin: 15% p95 on T4 sounds like kernel selection missed a memory-layout-friendly path. Did the autotuner consider the fused KV reorder kernel?

maria: It picked fused_attention_v2 by default for those runs. The autotuner's score function favored lower peak memory on T4 which pushed it to a less compute-optimal kernel for seqlen=1024.

lisa: Can you drop the exact perf snippet? p50/p95 + tokens/sec so we can compare presets. :eyes:

maria: paste below (all numbers median of 3 runs):

```
arch:A100  seq:1024  batch:8   tokens/sec: 18.2k  p50: 28ms  p95: 42ms
arch:H100  seq:1024  batch:8   tokens/sec: 20.4k  p50: 24ms  p95: 38ms
arch:L4    seq:1024  batch:8   tokens/sec: 10.5k  p50: 50ms  p95: 95ms
arch:T4    seq:1024  batch:8   tokens/sec: 9.8k   p50: 58ms  p95: 110ms  <- regression vs baseline
arch:A10   seq:1024  batch:8   tokens/sec: 11.1k  p50: 46ms  p95: 88ms
```

aj: That p95 jump on T4 is huge. What's the KV miss/hit ratio? Does our KV caching layer trigger an allocation path that GC's?

maria: KV hit rate stayed constant (~96%). The issue is a reorder+transpose kernel we fall back to when the fused kernel is disabled for memory reasons. On T4 that fallback has poor shared-memory utilization and stalls at higher seqlens.

profiling-bot: autotune-run:1845678800 summary attached. Hotspots: attention_reorder (46%), kv_transpose (21%), softmax (12%).

kevin: Ok — proposal: add an arch-aware rule that prefers fused_attention_v2 for seqlen >= 512 on T4/L4/A10 unless per-batch memory > threshold X. This keeps short-seq gains while avoiding reorder fallback on long runs.

lisa: Also add a micro-batch heuristic: if realtime latency SLO < 50ms, force small-kernel path for seq<=128. That keeps PLG latency tight.

aj: I like both. We should codify as presets so Dedicated and Private can pin them. Example preset (draft):

```
{
  "preset_name": "cross-arch-balanced-v1",
  "rules": [
    {"arch": ["T4","L4","A10"], "seq_len_min": 512, "kernel": "fused_attention_v2", "memory_override_threshold": 6.0},
    {"seq_len_max": 128, "kernel": "small_attn_fastpath"}
  ],
  "notes": "Prefer fused path for long seq on small GPUs; small-kernel for ultra-low latency short seqs."
}
```

maria: Implemented the rule locally and reran quick checks. T4 p95 improved from 110ms -> 62ms for seq=1024, tokens/sec up 18%. Loss on seq=32 path is ~4% tokens/sec but p50 stays low.

lisa: Nice tradeoff. Any memory regression?

maria: Peak memory +0.8GB on T4 for the fused path at batch=8/seq=1024 — still under our per-GPU limit. We should gate by Dedicated contract sizes though.

aj: We should also add an autotune scoring adjustment: penalize kernels that cause >20% variance in p95 across runs. That prevents stochastic regressions from being selected.

kevin: Good call. Also flag the KV transpose codepath for optimization — it's the second hotspot. I'll take an action to prototype a tiled transpose that uses async copy on L4/T4.

profiling-bot: perf-alert:detected perf-regression candidate in nightly-1845678000 for model:gpt-like-13b on arch:T4 seqlen:1024. Link: https://perf.internal/runs/1845678000

maria: I'll attach the autotune config used and the logs to the perf run.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy queued for preset: cross-arch-balanced-v1 -> target: canary pool (5% traffic). Requested by maria.

lisa: Let's watch the canary for 2 hours then promote. Also add a regression monitor that looks at p95 delta vs baseline per-arch.

aj: One more note — A100/H100 still prefer the big-kernel path for long seqs but they already used it. Main value here is preventing small-GPU fallbacks that hurt p95.

kevin: I'll post a PR with the tiled-transpose prototype and a microbenchmark. Expect by EOD tomorrow.

maria: Thanks all. Will follow up with the canary dashboard + tuned presets JSON and a short runbook for ops. :thumbsup:
